decisions.decision:
Start now. Build it all outside the product first.
(1) Write the result metrics in docs/retention/result-metrics.md, one per customer type: agency/RevOps = revenue influenced (meetings booked and pipeline from Tantra campaigns); founder-led B2B = hours saved (sends, replies and calendar invites automated × minutes per task); ops teams = processes automated (live campaigns and workflows). Each metric names the Tantra API field it reads from (see integrations-tantra-api.md).
(2) Build a local monthly report generator: per-workspace HTML and email, Backlinko voice, no invented stats.
(3) Write the retention factor into the T-153 scoring rubric (requests from at-risk or high-result accounts score higher) and commit it as a shared rubric file.
(4) Send the first reports only to [email] as 'Adi test'.
(5) Hand Amal the finished reports to review. Bharath signs off before any change to tantra-backend-v2 (branch development).
